hits.title: Avaya, ASAPP Name New CEOs as CX Leadership Turnover Continues
hits.snippet: ### The Gist - **Two announcements, one day apart.Avaya named Jeff Clarke CEO on Aug. 3, and ASAPP named Katie Stein CEO on Aug. 4, putting two contact center and customer experience vendors under new leadership within 24 hours of each other.** - **Different companies, similar bet.Avaya is leaning on Clarke's turnaround record at legacy tech giants, while ASAPP is leaning on Stein's operating background at Atain and Genpact to scale its agentic AI platform.** - **Part of a bigger pattern.The moves extend a run of CEO changes across CX and CCaaS vendors that includes NICE, Medallia, Five9, Verint and Qualtrics since the start of 2025.** - **Industry reaction was swift.Analysts and consultants took to LinkedIn within hours of the Avaya news, drawing comparisons to Clarke's Kodak tenure and debating whether a private-equity operator is the right fit for the moment.** Enterprise communications provider Avaya and AI contact center vendor ASAPP each announced new chief executives this week, on consecutive days, adding two more names to a leadership carousel that has spun through much of the customer experience technology sector since 2025. ## ASAPP Taps Katie Stein to Scale Its Platform
